semiconductor_relevance: High — ZEISS Korea specializes in high-precision optics and photomasks essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: ZEISS Korea provides advanced optical solutions for semiconductor production, including photomasks and EUV optics for lithography. Their offerings extend to microscopy and metrology solutions that support process control, inspection, and quality assurance in semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.Korea: ZEISS Korea actively participates in the local semiconductor industry, showcasing their solutions at events like SEMICON Korea 2026.
